declarations.name: Research.FloatingPoint.Model.mk
declarations.type:
(u : Real) →
  LE.le.{0} 0 u →
    (round : Real → Real) →
      (∀ (z : Real),
          ∃ δ, And (LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} δ) u) (Eq.{1} (round z) (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} z (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 δ)))) →
        Research.FloatingPoint.Model

declarations.body:
fun x x_1 x_2 =>
  List.brecOn.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real → Real) x
    (fun x f x_3 x_4 =>
      (match (motive :=
          (x : List.{0} Real) → Real → Real → List.below.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real → Real) x → Real) x,
          x_3, x_4 with
        | List.nil.{0}, x, x_5 => fun x => 0
        | List.cons.{0} a tail, x, u => fun x_5 =>
          let v := Research.Horner.P tail x;
          let e := x_5.1 x u;
          HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} u (abs.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} x v))))
            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 u)
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} u (abs.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} x v)))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 u) (abs.{0} x)) e))))
        f)
    x_1 x_2

declarations.type:
(motive : List.{0} Real → Real → Real → Sort u_1) →
  (x : List.{0} Real) →
    (x_1 x_2 : Real) →
      ((x x_3 : Real) → motive List.nil.{0} x x_3) →
        ((a : Real) → (tail : List.{0} Real) → (x u : Real) → motive (List.cons.{0} a tail) x u) → motive x x_1 x_2

declarations.body:
fun x x_1 =>
  List.brecOn.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real) x
    (fun x f x_2 =>
      (match (motive := (x : List.{0} Real) → Real → List.below.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real) x → Real) x,
          x_2 with
        | List.nil.{0}, x => fun x => 0
        | List.cons.{0} a tail, x => fun x_3 => HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} x (x_3.1 x)))
        f)
    x_1

declarations.name: Research.Horner.P.match_1
declarations.type:
(motive : List.{0} Real → Real → Sort u_1) →
  (x : List.{0} Real) →
    (x_1 : Real) →
      ((x : Real) → motive List.nil.{0} x) →
        ((a : Real) → (tail : List.{0} Real) → (x : Real) → motive (List.cons.{0} a tail) x) → motive x x_1

declarations.body:
fun model x x_1 =>
  List.brecOn.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real) x
    (fun x f x_2 =>
      (match (motive := (x : List.{0} Real) → Real → List.below.{1, 0} (motive := fun x => Real → Real) x → Real) x,
          x_2 with
        | List.nil.{0}, x => fun x => 0
        | List.cons.{0} a tail, x => fun x_3 =>
          Research.FloatingPoint.Model.round model
            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} a (Research.FloatingPoint.Model.round model (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} x (x_3.1 x)))))
        f)
    x_1

Research.Horner.forward_error
declarations.type:
∀ (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model) (coefficients : List.{0} Real) (x : Real),
  LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Research.Horner.Q model coefficients x) (Research.Horner.P coefficients x)))
    (Research.Horner.E coefficients x (Research.FloatingPoint.Model.u model))
